milestone: W10B first live webcam Studio session
objective: One bounded live session driven from the W10 Studio window: the operator frames the shot live (zoom/pan/mirror/rotate) while the exact 16x16 matrix streams, and ends it with the Stop button. Proves the product path end to end: absolute-deadline scheduler, unchanged/duplicate suppression with heartbeat, and a clean operator stop. Not a rate measurement and not a panel-refresh claim.

readiness.required_followup: Execute only bash scripts/run_webcam_w10_once.sh, once. Never replay after any outcome.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target; no target override

transport.connection_shape: one connection; one frame in flight; one ACK per frame
transport.one_controller_rule: After a fresh named grant only: stop the MCP product supervisor and verify the Host idle; Android Divoom app disconnected. OpenTivoo and port 8779 untouched. Wait the 8 s handover settle window before opening. Restore MCP separately under its existing Runtime 003 policy after terminal close.

build.source_checkpoint: f647ca4bd6e36ea3c7e087164370efecdcd22b9a + Studio build staged at C:\temp\openditoo-webcam-studio-w10

session.shape: W10 absolute-deadline scheduler in `max` mode: logical slots every 50 ms; earliest send = max(next slot, last real send + 50 ms) against the unchanged 40 ms Host streaming backstop; missed slots are skipped and counted, never made up; one frame in flight, prior ACK always required, zero packet spacing, pipelining forbidden. A duplicate SourceId or byte-identical 16x16 frame is not transmitted and does not move either clock; a quiet scene is kept alive with /v1/session/heartbeat instead of resends.

stream.source_description: NexiGo VID_0C45 PID_2690 live camera framed by the operator in the W10 Studio window; WinRT Realtime freshest-frame slots; srgb_area transform with operator-adjustable zoom/pan/mirror/rotation and the deterministic 255-colour guard.

live_source.producer_description: W10 Studio (runtime/windows/OpenDitoo.Webcam.Studio): StudioCamera + StudioSender + StudioForm, linking the 007-frozen transform, encoder, slot and typed-session files read-only. SourceId assigned once at acquisition as in W9A.

transform.initial_framing_source: %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenDitoo\webcam-framing.json (defaults zoom 1, centred, mirrored, 0 turns); recorded as framingAtStart/framingAtEnd
transform.envelope_note: Framing changes pixel content only. Budgets already assume the encoder worst case, so no framing can move packets, bytes or timing.

live_source.privacy: No saved camera stills or video; metrics only

optical_observation.stimulus: tools/w9a_motion_truth_stimulus.html driven by requestAnimationFrame at the monitor refresh rate
optical_observation.stimulus_decoder: host/motion_truth.py 4x4 cell code; all 4096 counter values verified to round-trip the real production transform
optical_observation.analysis: host/w9b_optical.py via cli/w9b.py; offline, file-only, no device surface
optical_observation.external_camera: operator phone slow-motion; monitor and Ditoo must share one exposure so no clock alignment is required
optical_observation.quantisation_note: 240 fps footage quantises latency to ~4.167 ms; report it, never interpolate through it.
optical_observation.not_evidence_of: Optical results are physical-display evidence only. They are never transport evidence, and transport FPS is never panel FPS.

budgets.derivation: min(floor(60000 / 50) + 1, 500 Host cap) = 500 frames; 500 * 3 = 1500 packets; 500 * 1054 worst-case application bytes = 527000. At the W8-005 ACK rate the frame budget, not the lifetime, ends a busy scene at roughly 30 s; both are clean terminals.

stop_immediately_on: camera missing or no valid first frame before claim/open
camera disconnect, stall (>2 s without a frame) or transform exception
Host profile not confirmed as streaming_ack_clock
target, firmware, source or executable hash mismatch
any Host refusal, HTTP/send fault or ACK timeout
Host session no longer active at heartbeat
operator Stop button, window close or Ctrl+C
60 second lifetime or frame/byte budget reached
stop_policy.on_camera_disconnect: Stop new submissions, request close once. Ambiguous close is unknown. Never resend, reconnect or reclaim; camera reconnect exists in preview only.
stop_policy.on_host_fault: Terminal unknown; never resend or retry; cleanup must not overwrite unknown.
stop_policy.source_cleanup: Cancel capture/processor and dispose the reader/camera. Collection-continuation flag refers to existing MCP collection, not retaining webcam capture.
stop_policy.recovery: Restore the MCP product separately under Runtime 003 after verifying experiment terminal ownership; do not overlap controllers.

acceptance.transport: One clean session: terminal stopped_clean with operator_stop, lifetime_expired or budget_exhausted; zero retries/reconnects/reclaims/pacing refusals/encoder-hash mismatches; Host ledger totals equal client totals.
acceptance.scheduler: duplicateSelections and sourceIdentity duplicate/out-of-order selections all zero; skippedSlots and unchangedFrames reported, never transmitted.
acceptance.operator: Owner confirms on the Ditoo: framing changes made in the Studio window during the session appear on the panel, and Stop ends the session with the last frame left static.
acceptance.separation: ackedTransportFps is ACKed transport only. Panel refresh and visible unique-frame cadence remain UNMEASURED (W9B deferred); no claim about them may be drawn from this session.

persistence_analysis.forbidden: firmware, gallery/persistent uploads, raw send, target selection, command enumeration, pipelining
persistence_analysis.product_policy_effect: none; Runtime 003 is not webcam authority and does not widen; standing webcam authority is a separate owner decision

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE live W10 Studio session, at most 60 s, to exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 v42012 via the existing typed Host 127.0.0.1:8796 and streaming_ack_clock profile: 40 ms Host floor, 50 ms client floor, absolute 50 ms slots with missed slots skipped, at most 500 frames / 1500 packets / 527000 application bytes, one connection, one frame in flight, heartbeat on a quiet scene; operator-adjustable framing; no retry/reconnect/reclaim/pipelining; suspend and restore Runtime 003 separately. Confers no standing webcam authority. Grants for N980P-001..007 are separate and confer nothing.

adapter.claim_handshake: Studio must produce one fresh valid 16x16 frame and show its window before emitting camera_ready + nonce; WSL creates the durable one-use claim only then, and only execute:<nonce> crosses the claim boundary.
